    4. Initialize a defaultdict d with default value 0 (bug is here).
    5. Iterate over each element a in a_list, incrementing the count of a in d.
    6. Initialize ans to 0.
    7. For each pair of elements (p, q) in a_list, compute the product p * q, take it modulo m, and add the count of this result in d to ans.
    8. Print the final value of ans.
]
